about_the_game:
DETOUR is a single-player driving adventure through a mysterious sci-fi landscape. Upgrade your truck, manage scarce resources, and chart your own path across quiet rural backroads. Scavenge materials, adapt to the unknown, and uncover the hidden truths of a world quietly ruled by an artificial intelligence.

Features

  • Drive into the unknown – Explore rural backroads scarred by brutalist structures, where every landmark whispers of the AI’s hidden past.

  • Your truck, your lifeline – Upgrade and reshape your machine with tools and abilities that open new paths, solve puzzles, and change the way you play.

  • An AI that watches – Outsmart the intelligence that governs the land, turning its behavior into a weapon, a puzzle piece, and a story of control versus autonomy.

  • Survival in every load – Manage resources through a dynamic storage system where weight, shape, and damage transform every haul into a puzzle.

  • A world built to be uncovered – Discover secrets and new routes in a condensed open world designed for curiosity, mystery, and replay.

A Road Ruled by Machines

Drive across rural backroads and discover a world quietly ruled by machines. DETOUR is a single-player driving adventure about exploration, survival, and the strange relationship between humanity and artificial intelligence.

The Truck Is the Protagonist

Upgrade your truck and use it as more than just transport — demolish barriers, carry heavy loads, and solve puzzles that reshape the path ahead. Every tool you add changes how your machine looks and plays, turning it into the true protagonist of your journey.

An AI That Watches

The AI that governs this world is not just an enemy. It watches, guides, and interferes. Learn its behavior, bend it to your advantage, and decide how much control you’re willing to surrender.

Landscapes of Contrast

Explore handcrafted landscapes where Spanish rural beauty collides with stark brutalist architecture. Discover hidden details through light, perspective, and silence. Manage your cargo in a dynamic storage system that makes every resource a puzzle under pressure.

The Atmosphere of the Road

Above all else, DETOUR is about the atmosphere — the road stretching ahead, the hum of your machine, the quiet tension of a world caught between nature and technology, and the secrets waiting just out of sight.
